recette.accroche: How well do you know your partner?
recette.consigne: 8 questions, 5 seconds each. Count your right answers!
questions: Who is your partner's best friend?
Who do they call when they feel sad?
How many brothers or sisters do they have?
Which family member are they closest to?
What do they call their grandparents?
Who is the person that makes them laugh?
Which friend do they see every week?

fin.question: How many did you get? Comment your score!

en.legende:
Family edition: 8 questions about your partner's friends and family. Do you know them well?

Comment your score!
